changes: Separate twelve-key registry family, independently policy-verified typed wallet tickets and all nine ordered pair modes.
Selection covers every count 1..64, with canonical odd-tail padding and terminal depth-six finalization.
Typed cache and recovery reverify wallets and nodes using the host-supplied registry, chain and policy resolver.
Checkpoint restoration rejects an operation tag that disagrees with the job rederived from verified inputs.
Legacy CPU packets and workers reject typed jobs; live typed GPU dispatch remains pending.
known_limits: Typed GPU worker packets, persistent dispatch and supervisor integration remain unimplemented.
GPU reservations must use each assigned device and the existing calibrated host/resource planner.
No active proving-worker termination or integrated arrival recovery qualification.
No new solving-time or delivered-throughput measurement.
Shared larger geometries, cold full-64, post-seal gates and Mac repetitions remain open.

resource_admission.capture_scope: Live inventory and read-only admission for the previously qualified paired count-four two-worker assignment. No proving job launched. Count-four context calibration does not qualify other counts.

retained_attempt_notes: First typed test exposed the missing checkpoint operation comparison; the failed test and source archive are retained.

First replay succeeded. Final replay updates diagnostic wording to identify the retained wallets explicitly.
